items.title: Turn on the lights under the bar and the disco ball (kitchen switch).
items.title_es: Prende las luces de abajo de la barra y la bola disco (el switch de la cocina).

items.title: Open all the doors.
items.title_es: Abre todas las puertas.

items.title: Check for packages and deliveries. Open them, stock what you can, and break down the boxes.
items.title_es: Revisa si llegaron paquetes o entregas. Ábrelos, acomoda lo que puedas y desarma las cajas.

items.title: Patio setup.
items.title_es: Prepara el patio.
detail: Red bench cushions out
Umbrellas out and secured to the base
Sweep and wipe the green marble in the courtyard
Outdoor speaker out, plugged in, cable tucked

proof.prompt: The patio set and courtyard clean: cushions out, umbrellas up and secured, marble swept, speaker out and plugged in

items.title: Music on the outside speaker. Wipe down the stereo and speakers.
items.title_es: Pon música en la bocina de afuera. Limpia el estéreo y las bocinas.

items.title: Count the register. It should be $210.
items.title_es: Cuenta la caja. Debe tener $210.

proof.prompt: The opening drawer count. It should be $210.

items.title: Dial in the Spro.
items.title_es: Calibra la Spro.

items.title: Set up the cafe bar: syrups, pitchers, scales, rags for the knock box, steam wand and cleaning.
items.title_es: Prepara la barra del café: jarabes, jarras, básculas, trapos para el knock box, el vaporizador y la limpieza.

proof.prompt: The cafe bar set: syrups, pitchers, scales and rags in place

items.title: Brew the freshest half-batch of drip coffee.
items.title_es: Prepara medio lote de café de filtro bien fresco.

items.title: Ice run to the hood. Fill the ice well.
items.title_es: Trae hielo del hood. Llena la hielera.

items.title: Iced tea.
items.title_es: Té helado.
detail: Pull any prepped iced tea that is ready
Strain it through a wet drip filter
Store it in the fridge

items.title: Pull the tap covers off the cold brew lines, soak in warm water, store behind the draft menu.
items.title_es: Quita las tapas de las llaves del cold brew, remójalas en agua tibia y guárdalas detrás del menú de draft.

items.title: Sanitize and wipe the bar, coffee counter and tables.
items.title_es: Sanitiza y limpia la barra, el counter del café y las mesas.

items.title: Hard clean, brush not rag.
items.title_es: Limpieza a fondo, con cepillo no con trapo.
detail: Degrease every table base and pedestal, floor side included
Scrub every chair base, chair leg and barstool foot ring
Scrub all bench bases and legs, back side against the wall too
If the brush comes up black, go again

proof.prompt: Table bases, chair legs and bench bases scrubbed, nothing black left on the brush

items.title: Restroom: clean, sanitize, stock towels, TP and rum hand soap.
items.title_es: Baño: limpia, sanitiza y surte toallas, papel y el jabón de manos de ron.

proof.prompt: The restroom clean and stocked: towels, TP and rum hand soap

items.title: Perimeter sweep.
items.title_es: Barre el perímetro.
detail: Patio corner to corner, under every table and bench
Front sidewalk across the whole building, curb line included
Street side of the patio, all the way around
Lot side of the patio, all the way around

proof.prompt: A 30 second walk of the full perimeter loop: patio, sidewalk, street side, lot side

items.title: Call in any dirty outside conditions to Clean & Safe: graffiti, spills, broken glass, biohazard.
items.title_es: Reporta a Clean & Safe cualquier cosa sucia afuera: grafiti, derrames, vidrio roto o riesgo biológico.

proof.prompt: What you called in to Clean & Safe, or nothing to report

items.title: Flag anything broken or not working to the MOD.
items.title_es: Avísale al MOD de cualquier cosa rota o que no sirva.

proof.prompt: Anything broken or not working, or none

items.title: Spray and wipe the black shelves along the side of HQ.
items.title_es: Rocía y limpia los estantes negros del lado de HQ.

proof.prompt: The black shelves along HQ wiped down

items.title: Fill tea bags. Pre-dose the morning coffee batches at 200 g.
items.title_es: Llena las bolsas de té. Pre-dosifica los lotes de café de la mañana a 200 g.

proof.prompt: Morning batches pre-dosed at 200 g

items.title: Stock syrups, milks, iced tea containers, cups, lids, straws, sugars and napkins.
items.title_es: Surte jarabes, leches, los recipientes de té helado, vasos, tapas, popotes, azúcares y servilletas.

proof.prompt: Cafe restocked: syrups, milks, cups, lids, straws, sugars, napkins

items.title: Deep clean the Curtis brewer with tablets and a clean water run. Dump the water and reset.
items.title_es: Limpia a fondo la cafetera Curtis con pastillas y un ciclo de agua limpia. Tira el agua y déjala lista.

proof.prompt: The Curtis brewer cleaned and reset, water dumped

items.title: Restroom: clean, sanitize, stock towels, TP and rum hand soap.
items.title_es: Baño: limpia, sanitiza y surte toallas, papel y el jabón de manos de ron.

proof.prompt: The restroom clean and stocked: towels, TP and rum hand soap

items.title: Empty every trash bin into the dumpsters, Space Ship included. New liners.
items.title_es: Vacía todos los botes de basura en los dumpsters, incluido el Space Ship. Pon bolsas nuevas.

proof.prompt: Every bin emptied and relined, Space Ship included

items.title: Put up the Order At Bar sign.
items.title_es: Pon el letrero de Order At Bar.

items.title: Tell the bartenders anything they need to know.
items.title_es: Dile a los bartenders lo que necesiten saber.

proof.prompt: Anything the bartenders need to know, or none

items.title: Beer tray: run hot water down it, then clean and reset.
items.title_es: Charola de cerveza: pásale agua caliente, luego límpiala y déjala lista.

proof.prompt: The beer tray cleaned and reset

items.title: Check for packages and orders, including the IFS order. Open them, put away and stock what you can, then tidy the space.
items.title_es: Revisa paquetes y pedidos, incluido el de IFS. Ábrelos, guárdalos y acomoda lo que puedas, luego ordena el área.

items.title: Pull empty boxes from upstairs.
items.title_es: Baja las cajas vacías de arriba.

items.title: Iced tea under the 1 L par? Prep more.
items.title_es: ¿El té helado está abajo del par de 1 L? Prepara más.

proof.prompt: Iced tea on hand, prepped if under the 1 L par

items.title: Polish all glassware and silverware.
items.title_es: Pule toda la cristalería y los cubiertos.

proof.prompt: Glassware and silverware polished

items.title: Run all ceramics and smallwares through the sanitizer. Dry and reset.
items.title_es: Pasa toda la loza y los utensilios chicos por el sanitizer. Sécalos y acomódalos.

items.title: Spro: backflush the groupheads, break down and clean the machine and the area under it.
items.title_es: Spro: haz backflush a los grupos, desarma y limpia la máquina y el área de abajo.

proof.prompt: The Spro broken down and cleaned, area underneath wiped

items.title: Check for printed J&T menus.
items.title_es: Revisa que haya menús de J&T impresos.

items.title: Consolidate cash tips.
items.title_es: Junta las propinas en efectivo.

proof.prompt: Cash tips consolidated

items.title: Charge the scales, whisk, tablet and vacuum.
items.title_es: Pon a cargar las básculas, el batidor, la tablet y la aspiradora.

items.title: Final wipe down: behind the cafe, the cage slush area, the back ledge.
items.title_es: Limpieza final: detrás del café, el área de la slush en la jaula y la repisa de atrás.

proof.prompt: Behind the cafe, the cage slush area and the back ledge wiped down

items.title: Call out any low stock.
items.title_es: Avisa de cualquier producto que esté bajo.

proof.prompt: Anything low on stock, or none

items.title: Clock in.
items.title_es: Marca tu entrada.

items.title: Spot sweep the bar. Bus and spot clean every table, floor and stool.
items.title_es: Barre los puntos de la barra. Levanta y limpia cada mesa, el piso y los bancos.

items.title: Check in with Cafe Close before they leave. Make sure their list is done.
items.title_es: Confirma con Cafe Close antes de que se vayan. Asegúrate de que terminaron su lista.

items.title: Check for packages and deliveries, including the milk order (whole milk and heavy cream). Open them, put away and stock what you can.
items.title_es: Revisa paquetes y entregas, incluido el pedido de leche (leche entera y crema para batir). Ábrelos, guárdalos y acomoda lo que puedas.

items.title: Fill the sanitizer bottle.
items.title_es: Llena la botella de sanitizer.

items.title: Prep.
items.title_es: Preparación.
detail: Well, polishing and sanitizing towels
Bar garnish and garnish bowls
Pacman of orange with backup
Lime wedges and wheels
Grapefruit quarters
Trim and shock mint
Cucumber wheels

proof.prompt: Garnish prepped and in bowls: orange pacman, limes, grapefruit quarters, mint, cucumber

items.title: Set up the well with citrus, simple and coffee amaro. Fill cheater bottles and keep them in the fridge until night service.
items.title_es: Prepara el well con cítricos, simple y coffee amaro. Llena las cheater bottles y guárdalas en el refri hasta el servicio de la noche.

proof.prompt: The well set: citrus, simple and coffee amaro; cheater bottles filled

items.title: Refill and reset the menu cocktail batch bottles. Check batches and make what is needed.
items.title_es: Rellena y resetea las botellas de batch de los cócteles del menú. Revisa los batches y haz los que falten.

proof.prompt: Which batches you made or topped off

items.title: Stock sparkling and garnish: sparkling water, prosecco, tonics, olives and cherries.
items.title_es: Surte lo burbujeante y la garnish: agua mineral, prosecco, tónicos, aceitunas y cerezas.

items.title: Ice: 8+ pans trimmed Big Rocks, 2 pans Kold-Draft, 1 full pan spears.
items.title_es: Hielo: 8+ charolas de Big Rocks cortados, 2 charolas de Kold-Draft, 1 charola llena de spears.

proof.prompt: The ice pans stocked to par: Big Rocks, Kold-Draft and spears

items.title: Restock backup spirits and the bottle wall from upstairs. Take out recycling.
items.title_es: Resurte los destilados de respaldo y el muro de botellas de arriba. Saca el reciclaje.

items.title: Stock dry goods: gloves, napkins, to-go boxes.
items.title_es: Surte los secos: guantes, servilletas, cajas para llevar.

items.title: Meats: sanitize the slicer, set and cover the meat with cheesecloth, line the tray with parchment.
items.title_es: Carnes: sanitiza la rebanadora, acomoda y cubre la carne con manta de cielo, forra la charola con papel encerado.

proof.prompt: The meat set and covered with cheesecloth, tray lined, slicer sanitized

items.title: Set up the snack bar with salt and the Tajin plate.
items.title_es: Prepara el snack bar con sal y el plato de Tajín.

items.title: Scrub the guest-facing stuff, gold sink and cutting board. Put away extra bottles and junk.
items.title_es: Talla lo que ve el cliente, el fregadero dorado y la tabla de cortar. Guarda las botellas de más y el tiradero.

items.title: Restroom: stock paper towels, TP and rum hand soap. Flag anything broken.
items.title_es: Baño: surte toallas de papel, papel y el jabón de manos de ron. Avisa si algo está roto.

proof.prompt: The restroom stocked: paper towels, TP and rum hand soap

items.title: Check in with Bar Open before they leave. Make sure their list is done.
items.title_es: Confirma con Bar Open antes de que se vayan. Asegúrate de que terminaron su lista.

items.title: Last call. Yell it, then check in with guests on last orders.
items.title_es: Last call. Grítalo, luego pregúntale a los clientes sus últimas órdenes.

items.title: Drop remaining checks and collect glassware.
items.title_es: Entrega las cuentas que falten y junta la cristalería.

items.title: Pre-close: pull cleaning tins, organize the back bar, get rid of mats.
items.title_es: Pre-cierre: saca los tins de limpieza, organiza el back bar y quita los tapetes.

items.title: Review batches and prep. Place a specialty produce order if under par. Note low or 86'd items in day notes.
items.title_es: Revisa los batches y el prep. Haz un pedido de producto especial si está abajo del par. Anota lo que esté bajo o en 86 en las notas del día.

proof.prompt: Batches and prep reviewed; low or 86'd items for the day notes

items.title: Bring in all outside furniture, neatly.
items.title_es: Mete todos los muebles de afuera, acomodados.

proof.prompt: All outside furniture brought in and stacked neatly, patio clear

items.title: Wash the pacman, jiggers, citrus bowls and anything left.
items.title_es: Lava el pacman, los jiggers, los tazones de cítricos y lo que quede.

items.title: Lights on, well off. Empty and clean the well.
items.title_es: Luces prendidas, well apagado. Vacía y limpia el well.

proof.prompt: The well emptied and clean

items.title: Clean the meat slicer.
items.title_es: Limpia la rebanadora de carne.

items.title: Scrape sticky residue and sanitize the tables and bar top. Reset the bar top with mats and trays.
items.title_es: Raspa lo pegajoso y sanitiza las mesas y la barra. Deja la barra lista con tapetes y charolas.

proof.prompt: The bar top scraped, sanitized and reset with mats and trays

items.title: Tables and dishes.
items.title_es: Mesas y trastes.
detail: Double check every table for missed items
Run a final load of dishes if needed
Wash the drip tray under the dirty glass rack
Clear the dump sink and ice cutting area
Wipe every barstool base and foot ring
Wipe every table base and pedestal, foot ring too
Broom out the sliding door track and cracks, both sides

proof.prompt: Every barstool and table base wiped, door track broomed, dump sink and ice area clear

items.title: Clean and replace the mats on the back bar and right of the dip sink.
items.title_es: Limpia y vuelve a poner los tapetes del back bar y a la derecha del dip sink.

items.title: Clean dishwasher areas 1 and 2.
items.title_es: Limpia las áreas 1 y 2 del lavaloza.

items.title: Reset the beer tap inserts. Fill the water bottles.
items.title_es: Resetea los insertos de las llaves de cerveza. Llena las botellas de agua.

items.title: Empty the red sani bucket. Soiled rags in the laundry bag.
items.title_es: Vacía la cubeta roja de sani. Los trapos sucios a la bolsa de lavandería.

items.title: Trash: bar, kitchen and rocket (toss citrus first). Break down recycling, compact, clean cans as needed.
items.title_es: Basura: barra, cocina y rocket (tira primero los cítricos). Desarma el reciclaje, compáctalo y limpia los botes según se necesite.

proof.prompt: All trash out, recycling broken down and compacted, cans clean

items.title: Add anything to the waste log.
items.title_es: Anota lo que vaya en el waste log.

proof.prompt: Anything added to the waste log, or none

items.title: Charge the Toast handhelds and iPad.
items.title_es: Pon a cargar los handhelds de Toast y el iPad.

items.title: Unplug the speaker and wrap the cord.
items.title_es: Desconecta la bocina y enrolla el cable.

items.title: Power down: stereo, disco ball, Post-It wall flood lights, upstairs lights, office lights, all AC.
items.title_es: Apaga todo: estéreo, bola disco, las luces del muro de Post-It, las luces de arriba, las de la oficina y todo el aire.

items.title: Cash out.
items.title_es: Corte de caja.
detail: Mode > Shift Review. Note the cash in hand amount
Pull exactly that amount from the drawer
Drawer should hold $210. If not, write the total on receipt paper and photo it
Trade cash tips for large bills in the drawer. Note the tip total
Cash Drawers > Close Drawer > gray number button > Close Drawer again
Stow cash with day reports, separate from cash sales, under the register

proof.prompt: The closed drawer. It should hold $210; if it is off, the total written on receipt paper

items.title: Close any open tabs. Wipe the POS screen with a microfiber.
items.title_es: Cierra las cuentas abiertas. Limpia la pantalla del POS con una microfibra.

items.title: Lock the main door, courtyard door and large euro door.
items.title_es: Cierra con llave la puerta principal, la del patio y la puerta euro grande.

proof.prompt: The main, courtyard and large euro doors locked

items.title: Final walkthrough. Everything reset for the opener.
items.title_es: Recorrido final. Todo listo para el que abre.

proof.prompt: Walk the room and record it: tables and bases, floor, bar reset, nothing left out

items.title: Leave shift notes. Clock out, live the dream.
items.title_es: Deja las notas del turno. Marca tu salida y vive el sueño.

proof.prompt: Shift notes for the next crew
